ai.summary: The page https://wildaid.org/ loaded in a headless browser with HTTP 200. The FundraiseUp install code is in the page source once, in the head, with no scripts after it. The widget script loaded from account ID AQTMUHNH. The browser did not click anything, so the checkout itself was not tested. Two donate links with form parameters were found. The page load event took 8.9 seconds, which is over the 6 second limit and is a warning, not a blocker. Three console errors were recorded, including one failed request and two 404 responses. No known cookie consent tool was detected. The Meta Pixel, GA4, and GTM containers were found in the page. The robots.txt allows the listed AI bots, llms.txt is present, and Organization markup is present. DonateAction markup is not present.

next_steps.action: Confirm with the customer which page elements produce the three console errors and the 404 responses, and whether the page speed issue is known.
Confirm with the customer whether they need a cookie consent setup for EU and UK visitors.
Test a donate link in a normal browser to confirm the checkout opens. The headless check did not click anything.
Fix the 404 and failed resource references on the page, and reduce page load time to under 6 seconds.

customer_email.subject: Next steps for your donation page at wildaid.org
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thanks for working with us to set up donations on wildaid.org. The donation widget is installed correctly and loads on your page. We found a few items to fix:

1. Reduce page load time. Your page took 8.9 seconds to finish loading. Please aim for under 6 seconds. Large images and scripts are common causes.

2. Fix broken resource links. We found three errors, including two 404 responses and one failed request. Please find the missing files or update the links that point to them.

3. Decide on cookie consent. If you have visitors in the EU or UK, you may need a cookie consent tool. Please let us know if you want help choosing one.

Once these are fixed, reply to this email and we will run the check again.

Thank you,
The Onboarding Team
